batch.head.other: I'm about to make these {count} changes in Home Assistant, in this order:

batch.unchecked: HA NOVA can't fully check what this would do.

batch.needs_you.other: One confirmation covers all {count}, so I need you to confirm it.

batch.copies: A copy of each one deleted is saved first, so it can be restored.
batch.no_copies: No copies could be saved, so once deleted they can't be restored.
batch.order: HA NOVA checks each one again right before it is sent and stops at the first one that doesn't go through.

batch.ask.other: Save all {count}? I can also show the details.

batch.phone.either.mixed.other: Change or delete {count} automations and scripts?

batch.result.done.other: Done: all {count} went through. I checked each one.

batch.result.no_copies: No copies were saved, as you chose.

batch.result.failed.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; Home Assistant refused {name}.

batch.result.unverified.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} was sent, but the check after it didn't pass.

batch.result.changed.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} changed since you saw it, so I stopped.

batch.result.not_sent.other: Partly done: {done} of {count} went through; {name} couldn't be sent.

batch.result.unknown.other: Not sure: {done} of {count} went through, and {name} may have too; I can't tell. I didn't try again.

batch.result.none_failed: Not done: Home Assistant refused {name}. Nothing changed.
batch.result.none_unverified: Not sure: {name} was sent, but the check after it didn't pass.
batch.result.none_unknown: Not sure: {name} may have gone through, and I can't tell. I didn't try again.

batch.drift.other: Not done: {names} changed since you saw the list, so nothing was sent.
